title: VersaTiles map (.mapjson), format version 1
description: A map of the VersaTiles map editor: its view, visible area, properties and elements. See packages/map-state/MAPJSON.md.

radius.description: The radius of the largest circle that the window shows, in meters.

view.description: The camera: where the author's editor looks, e.g. after a reload. Links for sharing and embedding leave it out; they show the `frame`, else the elements.

frame.description: The visible area: what a shared or embedded map shows completely, whatever the size and the shape of the window. Without it, the bounds of the elements are shown.

elements.description: The elements, in drawing order: the first one at the back, the last one in front.

$schema.description: The URL of the JSON Schema of the format version of the file, `MAPJSON_SCHEMA_URL`.

MapJSON.description: The content of a .mapjson file: a map state with the URL of its schema.

Position.description: A position on the map: longitude and latitude, in degrees (WGS 84).

Bounds.description: A geographic area: west, south, east and north, in degrees (WGS 84).

background.description: The background map. Without it, the map has the editor's default background.

legend.description: A legend, defined by the author, not generated from the elements.

colorScheme.description: The id of the color scheme offered for the map's colors. Without it, the default scheme.

viewer.description: What a shared or embedded map shows over it, and where: the search, the zoom buttons, the legend.

labelOverlap.description: Hide the labels of markers that would overlap other labels ("hide"); their symbols stay. Without it, all labels are shown, also on top of each other.

labelMinZoom.description: The zoom level from which the labels of markers are shown, with one decimal place, above 0 and up to 24, e.g. 12.5. Without it, at every zoom level.

mapLabelsOnTop.description: Draw the labels of the background map over the areas and lines of the elements. Without it, they are under them. The labels of markers are always on top.

title.description: The title of the map, e.g. for the list of maps, the title of the page and file names.

StateBackground.description: A background map built with `@versatiles/style`: the builder and its options, minimized (e.g. with `osm.minimizeOptions`). Storing the options instead of a preset keeps every current and future option of `@versatiles/style` available.

layout.description: How the entries are arranged. "inline" flows like text. Default: "vertical".

bold.description: The texts of all entries in bold. Default: false.

italic.description: The texts of all entries in italic. Default: false.

theme.description: The background and the border of the legend. Default: "light".

style.description: Markers: the symbol. Lines: the line. Polygons: the area.

StateLegendEntry.description: A row of the legend: a small copy of an element, and a text. Its styles are those of an element of its type, with the same defaults (see the elements); the label of a marker style is not shown.

halo.description: Markers: the width of the halo around the symbol and the label, in pixels.

pattern.description: Areas: the pattern of the fill.

patternScale.description: Areas with a pattern: its size, as a factor; at 1 the lines (across them) or the dots are 8 pixels apart. Only with a pattern.

patternCoverage.description: Areas with a pattern: the share of the area that its lines or dots cover, from 0.05 to 0.95. Only with a pattern.

dash.description: Lines and outlines: solid, dashed, dotted, long dashes, or dashes and dots.

rotate.description: Markers: the rotation of the symbol, in whole degrees clockwise.

size.description: Markers: the size of the symbol, as a factor.

labelSize.description: Markers: the size of the label, as a factor of 16 pixels.

width.description: Lines and outlines: the width, in pixels.

labelPosition.description: Markers: the position of the label around the symbol; "auto" where it fits, or on the point without a symbol.

color.description: The color of the symbol, the line, or the area, with its opacity.

label.description: Markers: the text of the label; "" for none.

visible.description: Outlines: whether the outline is drawn.

arrowStart.description: Lines: the arrowhead at the first point.

arrowEnd.description: Lines: the arrowhead at the last point.

arrowSize.description: Lines: the width of the arrowheads across the line, as a factor of the width of the line. Only with an arrowhead.

symbol.description: The symbol of a marker: the name of its image, e.g. "icons:anchor", or "" for none.

font.description: Markers: the glyph font of the label, e.g. "noto_sans_bold"; "" for the font of the labels of the background map.

labelColor.description: Markers: the color of the text of the label.

haloColor.description: Markers: the color of the halo around the symbol and the label.

StateStyle.description: The style of a marker, of a line, or of the area or the outline of a polygon or a circle. Which fields count depends on what it styles (see the elements); missing fields have their default.

HexColor.description: A color as hex code: "#rrggbb", or "#rrggbbaa" with its opacity (alpha). Written in lower case.

navigation.description: The buttons for zooming in and out. Default: "top-right".

legend.description: The legend, if the map has one: a side (centered) or a corner. Default: "bottom-left".

StateViewer.description: What the viewer shows over the map, and where: each at a position, or "none". Controls in the same corner are stacked. Defaults in `VIEWER_DEFAULTS`.

style.description: The symbol and its label (the style fields for markers).

StateElementMarker.description: A symbol at a point, with an optional label.

text.description: Plain text with simple formatting: **bold**, line breaks and links.

StatePopup.description: A popup that opens when the element is clicked or tapped in the viewer.

smooth.description: Drawn as a smooth curve through the points, instead of straight from point to point.

style.description: The line: its color, width and dashes, and the arrowheads (the style fields for lines).

smooth.description: Drawn as a smooth curve through the points, instead of straight from point to point.

style.description: The area: its color (with its opacity) and pattern (the style fields for areas).

strokeStyle.description: The outline: whether it is drawn, its color, width and dashes (the style fields for outlines).

StateElementPolygon.description: An area within points; the last point connects to the first one.

style.description: The area: its color (with its opacity) and pattern (the style fields for areas).

strokeStyle.description: The outline: whether it is drawn, its color, width and dashes (the style fields for outlines).
